results.primary: logistic minus unchanged HAT at the same eight random0 physical queries, mean patient SOZ AUROC
results.scope: Physically valid contact-posterior feasibility; not an agent comparison.

checks: Patient/source-model isolation and all map/model/bank/protocol hashes.
All physical-state training features reconstructed, labels checked against released references.
Both fitted contact predictors replayed at four/eight physical measurements; every AUROC/Brier independently recomputed; HAT matches v11.
limits: Recorded source/outer HAT outputs were not all re-inferred in this audit.

posthoc_calibration_diagnostic.observed_gap: Raw weighted-classifier scores are not directly calibrated SOZ probabilities.
posthoc_calibration_diagnostic.verified_training_code: Inverse-class and inverse-patient weighted sampling plus BCE positive weight n_negative/n_positive.
posthoc_calibration_diagnostic.causal_caveat: Weighting motivates a prior-correction test; finite training and partial-input distribution shift may also contribute.
